propertySets.name: Pset_CommunicationsApplianceTypeModem
propertySets.definition: Properties common to a modem. This property set is applied to a type or occurrence of IfcCommunicationsAppliance with predefined type MODEM.

properties.name: NumberOfCommonInterfaces
properties.definition: Indicates the number of common interfaces on the device.

properties.name: NumberOfTrafficInterfaces
properties.definition: Indicates the number of traffic interfaces on the device.

properties.name: CommonInterfaceType
properties.definition: Indicates the type of the device common interfaces.

properties.name: TrafficInterfaceType
properties.definition: Indicates the type of the device traffic interfaces.

propertySets.name: Pset_DataTransmissionUnit
propertySets.definition: Properties common to a data transmission unit. This property set is applied to a type or occurrence of IfcCommunicationsAppliance with predefined type MODEM.

properties.name: WorkingState
properties.definition: Indicates the working state of device or system.

properties.name: SerialInterfaceType
properties.definition: Indicates the type of serial interface used by the device.

properties.name: DataTransmissionUnitUsage
properties.definition: Indicates the usage of the data transmission unit. It can be used to transmit data for different types of sensors.
